packages.title: Nebula

manifest.title: Nebula
manifest.appDescription: Nebula — add-on browser + player for webOS. An Apple TV-style player (glass controls, thick rounded scrubber, remaining time), a featured hero board, full-bleed title pages with logo art and cast, My List with an upcoming-episode calendar, resume and Continue Watching, next-episode autoplay, sync between devices with a short code, subtitle appearance controls, and search across every catalogue. Opens full on first run. Plays and decrypts every format.

packages.shortDescription: Add-on browser + player: library, sync, calendar. Add add-ons by phone QR.
